args.description: an adult woman with very long silver-white hair with a faint lavender tint, tied in a high flowing ponytail with a cluster of red and gold beads and long red ribbons, a long front lock and one ahoge strand, red eyes with small red marks under them, a black sleeveless high-collared top with gold embroidery and a gold pendant, bare shoulders, a long white coat with gold trim, red and orange flame patterns and a red lining, worn slipped down off the shoulders to the elbows, wide sleeves with gold cuffs, a wide red belt with gold studs and a big gold buckle with a red gem, a red and gold front sash with orange flame patterns, a red tassel at the hip, black fingerless gloves with gold trim, baggy black trousers gathered at the shins, red and black boots with gold buckles. Her very long slender curved odachi of the second reference is sheathed: the whole long blade is inside its scabbard, exactly the scabbard of the first reference (dark red with gold flame patterns, gold rings, red cord with a gold bead and a red tassel), as long as the blade, worn through her belt at her left hip, slanting slightly down toward the back: the mouth of the scabbard is in front of her left hip and its long end sticks out far behind her. Only the handle of the sword shows: it sticks out forward from the mouth of the scabbard, the spiky gold star-shaped guard against the mouth, the dark red wrapped grip and the gold pommel pointing forward. Her right hand grips the handle in front of her hip, her left hand holds the scabbard just behind the guard, the thumb on the guard. Full body, side view facing right, a still iai stance ready to draw: knees bent, the front foot forward, leaning slightly forward, a cold calm look, eyes narrowed. Same character design, hair, face, outfit and colours as the first reference. Only this character, her sheathed sword and its scabbard are drawn.
